title: Lost Wallet and Missing Debit Card
description: Customer lost their wallet on public transit and urgently needs to freeze their debit card and order a replacement.

customer_profile.name: David Miller
customer_profile.context_summary: Customer reports physical loss of wallet containing debit card ending in 3312 within the past hour.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Apex Bank Emergency Assistance, my name is Alex. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Help! I left my wallet on the commuter train thirty minutes ago and my debit card is inside. I need to block it immediately before anyone uses it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've immediately placed a permanent lock on card ending in 3312. No further transactions can go through. Are there any unauthorized charges on your account?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I just checked my app and there are no charges yet. Can you send me a replacement card with expedited delivery?

expected_summary.call_overview: Customer called to report a lost debit card and request an emergency replacement.
key_issues: Lost debit card on public transit.
required_followups: Replacement card arriving in 2 business days via FedEx
